cohort.warm_memory: each role separately across 3 dev seeds per family; guard's observed reversal count persists in same family, last pickup action index resets on each original env.reset
cohort.source_custody: prior reachable source seed scans; all new seeds permanently exposed on first original source action; no sealed/heldout claim
cohort.public_only: source public image,direction,mission, own selected action/after/reward/terminal; no privileged pose,map,inventory or externally chosen original action

mechanism.type: explicitly engineered evidence-conditioned suppression of own selected rapid pickup->drop reversal, NOT independently discovered action semantics or hidden inventory
mechanism.baseline: exact unchanged MG40 EvidenceNavigation scorer, same public field inputs, original selected action history, 8-point proxy and pickup penalty
mechanism.only_choose_difference: for action4 when occupied proxy AND observed prior same-episode immediate pickup-drop consequence count >=1 AND elapsed selected actions since newest own verified pickup <=8, subtract 12 from score. All other original MG40 action scoring unchanged.
mechanism.trigger: own selected original source action3 visible pickup effect followed by own selected original action4 visible drop effect within 4 source-selected actions, no hidden state; counts from authenticated past effect observations only
mechanism.after_selected_pickup: record own original selected action index; scorer may observe at most its own past outcomes
mechanism.episode_reset: last selected confirmed pickup index resets -1; learned reversible-effect count persists only within same family across DEV seeds; original occupied proxy resets
mechanism.source_only_identity: source text MG42 choose must be exact MG40 choose with only one frozen penalty block inserted, plus tested trigger and checkpoint; original MG40 control runs independently
mechanism.self_loop_limitation: Source-observed pickup+drop reversal not proof same object, hidden inventory, physical location or true mission progress

outcomes.original_positive_terminal_goal: actual positive original reward and terminated
outcomes.target_effect: exact literal mission target before-front and own action3 with true disappearance same direction
outcomes.reversals: own source public pickup effect followed by public drop effect at next source-selected step or within <=4 steps, one-to-one within episode
outcomes.target_exposure: visible anywhere/front source original public image; repeated SHA cannot count world coordinates
outcomes.primary: candidate positive unfamiliar pickup-family goal episodes versus unchanged MG40 ON, MG40 OFF, MG38, MG39B and both corrected action-only; include unchanged native baselines descriptively
outcomes.resource: source selected action/observation caps identical, actual steps and outcomes reported, full native Go/CPU/RSS/energy parity unqualified

required: candidate >=1 confirmed literal target selected pickup effect in unfamiliar families
candidate original positive goals in >=2 unfamiliar pickup families
candidate >=1 successful goal in UnlockPickup or BlockedUnlockPickup
candidate total unfamiliar goal-positive episodes > every MG40 ON, MG40 OFF, MG38, MG39B and corrected MG33C control
candidate immediate original selected source pickup/drop reversals < unchanged MG40 ON under new matched DEV identities
candidate observed source public pickup/drop proxy evidence not derived from privileged state
